==Ingredients==
*3 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]s (1400 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] strips 
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Liter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*1 cup (240 ml) chopped green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]]
*2 ribs [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], chopped
*2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
*½ cup (120 ml) [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] cooked [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]] 
*2 cans (29 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] / 800 g total) stewed [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] 
*2 cups (480 ml) [[Cookbook:Chicken Broth|chicken broth]]
*1 cup (240 ml) uncooked long grain [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Tbsp|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] 
*2 [[Cookbook:Tsp|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], crumbled 
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]] 
*1 ½ tsp salt, or to taste 
*¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

==Procedure==

#Heat olive oil in a large [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]]; add chicken and paprika, then brown on all sides. 
#Remove chicken from skillet. 
#Add onion, green bell pepper, celery, and garlic. [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] over low heat until onion is tender, about 10 minutes. 
#Stir in ham, tomatoes, chicken broth, rice, thyme, salt, and pepper. 
#Add chicken and turn to coat with sauce. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. 
#Reduce heat, cover, and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 15 minutes.
